$comment: scenario-world-referent — the escape hatch, and how it drains itself (doc 86 §10, §11).
WAVE 1: THE GATE IS ENFORCING. Run it with WORLD_REFERENT_GATE=report to get the wave-0
behaviour back for a bisect; every other invocation fails on a defect that is not written
down here. Four things are enforced and each can only ever shrink:
1. falsehoodBudget — a fault code that CONVICTS a student on a world that does not contain
its referent. A code absent from this block must have ZERO falsehoods; that is the flip.
A code present may not exceed its committed numbers, and a code BELOW them fails too,
with the number to write back. The block drains itself.
2. census — the machine-measured size of each ledger defect class. Every row must EQUAL the
number here, so a lane that repairs a class lowers this file in the same PR and the diff
is the proof of the win.
3. waveZero — the census this wave started from (expected-failures.json @ 8d32154). A row
measured ABOVE its wave-0 number needs a written entry in `raised`, or the gate fails.
Rows added in wave 1 carry null: the sharpened predicate did not exist at wave 0 and
inventing its wave-0 answer would be a number nobody measured.
4. allowlist — one entry per (scenario, rung, code) knowingly shipped red, each REQUIRING
scenario, rung, code, reason, owner and issue. An allowlisted entry that starts PASSING
fails the gate, so a lane that fixes something must delete its own entry.
The doc-86 ratchet is separate and untouched: for the four classes §10 counts to +/-0 the
measured number may never exceed the published one. See referents.ts LEDGER_BASELINE.
NOT ENFORCED, said plainly: the INERT band (22,485 rung-codes). An inert code is a declared
surface the world can never arm — a broken lesson, not a lie — and it is dominated by L12,
which has its own census row. Enforcing it would mean allowlisting the whole catalog.
WHAT MOVED IN WAVE 1, AND WHY A PREDICATE CHANGED (referents.ts carries the long form):
· T1 lane paint — rules/engine.ts:913 now requires tick.centreLinePainted before the three
lane-keeping codes may fire, so an unpainted edge DISARMS them instead of convicting on
geometry. Unpainted is no longer a falsehood; it is inert or irrelevant.
· T4 speed plates — the rule always required 'a face whose NUMBER equals edge.maxspeed'. At
wave 0 the kit had one numeral, so that collapsed to 'is this edge 50?'. Lane 3 built the
other twelve, so the collapsed form now scores correctly-signed 20 and 90 roads as lies.
T4raw keeps the collapsed form visible.
· T3b / S1 — guidanceGoalFor takes an optional context and resolves a passSignal against the
runtime's stop lines only when given one. Wave 0 passed none and therefore graded the
template; wave 1 passes the real one and grades the product.
· S5 6 -> 7 (2026-08-14, title-honesty pass; wave-0 was 8, so no `raised` entry is owed and
the gate would call one stale). sc-sig-flash-amber-ped joined the row when its approach gate
stopped certifying «намалена скорост» at 35 and started asking for the 30 the drill teaches
in its own instructions — the rule engine's crossingApproachMaxKmh. The sweep is the
constant-speed closed form and it drives the CROSSING CENTRELINE, 4.06 m left of the lane
the player is actually in, so it reports a 0.195 m graze where the committed no-yield
recording at 28 km/h passes her by ~3 m. It is the same class the other six carry: a drill
whose staged hazard exists precisely so the student must STOP, measured by a sweep that
models only the speed half of obeying (referents.ts checkS5 states that caveat itself).
Lowering the cap made the lesson slower and stricter, not less survivable.
· T14 4 -> 0 (2026-08-19, never-edited-world-builders lane; wave-0 was 10, so nothing is owed
in `raised`). T14 counts a hazard warning standing AT the hazard instead of before it. Over
all nine curveAdvisory/waterPatch/icePatch zones in the corpus, six always got their full
60 m; the other three could not, and zoneSigns.ts clamped them onto the hazard: d2-v1 6.0 m,
district-v1's e892658655.0 and mw-exit-v1's ramp -1.0 m each — a sign whose whole content is
„ahead" pointing at „here". zoneSigns.ts now walks to the road the driver ARRIVES DOWN when
the zone's own edge cannot hold the advance, and refuses to post at all when even that fails.
d2-v1 6.0 -> 53.8 m, mw-exit -1.0 -> 61.0 m, district-v1's fromM-0 curve posts nothing (the
road turns 47.4° into it, so there is no approach to borrow). The six untouched placements are
byte-identical. What SURVIVES is counted elsewhere and named there, not dropped: see the
SPEED_TOO_FAST_FOR_CURVE budget entry below.
· T8 / B4 — both were counts of a FEATURE (capped reachZones). T8 now counts caps the marker
still does not state; B4 probes the evaluator once, because one stateless stepReachZone
broke all of them at once and one latch repaired all of them at once. T8raw / B4raw keep
the wave-0 totals.

WRONG_WAY.owner: the roundabout lane (world/builders/props.ts В1 pass) + the d2-v1 OSM gate
WRONG_WAY.reason: 19 scenarios / 88 rungs -> 6 / 29. The TERMINAL mouth pass (network.onewayTerminalNoEntryEdges + the props.ts В1 terminal pass) closed the thirteen maps whose one-way edge simply has no junction on it — motorway carriageways, the lane-drop merge, the roadworks shift, the gantry street: the В1 now stands at the downstream mouth facing back along the flow, which is how a Bulgarian one-way street is actually signed. What is LEFT is two things, and neither is a sign the founder can be shown today. (a) FIVE ROUNDABOUT scenarios (sc-rb-exit-signal / -circulate-priority / -busy-gap / -lane-choice / -ped-exit): a ring arm is one-way by construction and its ENTRY is legal, so the illegal mouth of a ring is its exit arms — a derivation the roundabout lane owns, and one that must not be guessed while that lane is reshaping the ring geometry. (b) sc-ed-d2-priority-run on d2-v1: the В1 pass is deliberately gated to scenario micro-maps, because OSM never recorded the real signage of the ~150 one-way mouths in that district and posting there would trade a missing sign for an invented one.

SPEED_TOO_FAST_FOR_CURVE.owner: referents.ts (the predicate) + mw-exit-v1.json / gen_mw_exit.mjs (the В26-60 plate)
SPEED_TOO_FAST_FOR_CURVE.reason: REWRITTEN 2026-08-19, never-edited-world-builders lane. The old text — „the А1 post on mw-exit-v1 stands 1.0 m PAST the arc" — is fixed and no longer the cause. zoneSigns.ts now posts that А1 61.0 m before the arc, on mwx-e-nb-decel at s=219 of 280, which is where a motorway exit is signed in life; measured, and T14 fell 4 -> 0 in the same pass. TWO things keep the code red, and NEITHER is in zoneSigns.ts. (a) THE PREDICATE IS EDGE-LOCAL: checkSPEED_TOO_FAST_FOR_CURVE projects candidate posts onto the ZONE'S OWN edge and drops anything more than 20 m off it, so an А1 on the approach is invisible to it and it now reports „curve post is not on the zone's own edge". Worse, its arithmetic makes this zone unsatisfiable from any sign placement whatever: bestLead = fromM - sM with fromM = 0 and sM >= 0, so bestLead <= 0 < 40 for every post that could ever project onto mwx-e-ramp. Following the geometric predecessor (the same join zoneSigns.ts now measures: the ramp head sits 8.13 m from the decel lane's end, inside that edge's 16.19 m half width, 0.0° of heading break) is the fix. (b) THE NUMBER IS STILL NOWHERE: the engine grades tick.curveAdvisoryKmh = 60 while the В26-60 plate is refused, because posting a 60 face on a 140 km/h carriageway is doc 86 T4's headline lie re-created by a warning sign — T4 is 0 and must stay 0. The honest fix for (b) is upstream of both files: give mwx-e-ramp a lead-in so its arc starts >= 63 m in (CURVE_PLATE_MIN_ROOM_M), which also makes (a) moot.
